title: Use the Cycleway Finder map
summary: Use the Cycleway Finder map to plan bicycling routes and find information about cycling paths in NSW.
intro:
Transport for NSW's Cycleway Finder is an interactive online map.

You can use it to work out bicycling routes in NSW.

You can search for an address on the map and see nearby cycling routes. If you click on a path, a pop up box will appear with information such as surface material, length, width and suburb.
